examTrap: Bẫy thường gặp trong đề thi: Đề bài thường đưa ra các phương án gần giống nhau về mặt ngữ pháp để gây nhiễu. Thí sinh cần đọc kỹ toàn bộ câu và xác định đúng dấu hiệu thời gian, chủ ngữ số ít/nhiều hoặc thể chủ động/bị động trước khi chọn.
translation: Dịch nghĩa câu: In order to achieve your ...___, you should be more hard-working.

detailedExplanation: Áp dụng nguyên tắc ngữ pháp chuyên đề 'Đại Từ & Lượng Từ (Quantifiers)': Phương án D ('nowhere') chuẩn xác nhất theo ngữ cảnh. Chú ý các dấu hiệu nhận biết để tránh bẫy của các phương án nhiễu A, B, C.
examTrap: Bẫy thường gặp trong đề thi: Đề bài thường đưa ra các phương án gần giống nhau về mặt ngữ pháp để gây nhiễu. Thí sinh cần đọc kỹ toàn bộ câu và xác định đúng dấu hiệu thời gian, chủ ngữ số ít/nhiều hoặc thể chủ động/bị động trước khi chọn.
translation: Dịch nghĩa câu: There was a lot of food at the party, but I only ate ..._.

passageText:
Q Upcoming Restaurant Opening By Ben MaxwellFairmount Daily Telegraph Contributor FAIRMOUNTLuigi's Kitchen will be open for business on Thursday, May 1st. Luigi's is another welcome addition to the many fine dining establishments located in Fairmount's waterfront district. Head Chef Luigi San Gregorio says, "Luigi's specializes in fine Italian cuisine derived from his native upbringing in Rome.

This delicious yet fairly common cuisine will be prepared to the highest possible standards using the finest ingredients. Customers can expect the freshest pasta, meats and seasonal vegetables . Our goal is to complete customer satisfaction and to ensure that they return over and over again." San Gregorio, formerly head chef at Chez Mario's, began making a plan to open his own restaurant in Fairmount over two years ago.

He evaluated several locations around the area but was set on the waterfront district. He ended up leasing space in the former garment warehouse building and helped pay for the renovations . San Gregorio added, "I worked closely with special architects and city planners to ensure that most of the original structure was preserved and in line with current city zoning laws.

We wanted to respect the rich history of this area." Luigi's is spectacular inside and out. It remains to be seen whether the food is as appealing as the decor. Luigi's Kitchen will be open Tuesday through Sunday for lunch and dinner.

The menu offers a wide selection of pricing options with the average price of a dinner being comparable to most restaurants in the waterfront district.

Ronald Simpson Ill Internal Office

Date: Saturday, June 17 Speaker: Ryu Maruyama Edinburgh Museum Wins Prestigious Design Award August 8. EdinburghThe Edinburgh Museum has won first place in the Publication Design Contest, sponsored annually by the European Museum Association, for its current exhibition, "Ancient Civilizations: Anthropological Artifacts and their stories". The cover of the program for the exhibit features a photo montage of rock carvings from 10,000 B.C. The photographs were taken by renowned photographer, Alicia Coughlin . This year, the Publication Design Contest attracted 211 submissions by 53 museums across Europe. Entries included books, calendars, educational materials, invitations, brochures, newsletters, posters, and websites. The Edinburgh Museum is located just a few blocks from City Hall and is open on Tuesday through Saturday from 9:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M. It is closed on Mondays , Sundays, and on all national holidays. The upcoming exhibit, "The Future is Now" features high tech methods used to extract and study fossils and bones.
